title: Equipment & Vehicle Loans — Insurance Lapse Cure Periods and Collateral Protection Rates
content:
Proof of physical-damage insurance on every unit pledged to an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan must stay current. When renewed proof is late, each product allows a cure period, and the products that place collateral protection insurance do so at the annual rate shown.

| Product | Insurance lapse cure period (calendar days after the expiry date on record) | Collateral protection placed by the association | Collateral protection annual premium (% of principal at placement) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | 15 | yes | 6.5 |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | 30 | no | 0 |
| Used Equipment Loan | 30 | no | 0 |
| New Equipment Loan | 30 | no | 0 |
| Irrigation System Loan | 30 | no | 0 |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | 30 | no | 0 |

## Definitions

- **Insurance lapse cure period** — the calendar days after the insurance expiry date on record by which renewed proof of insurance must be received.
- **Collateral protection placed by the association** — whether the association places collateral protection insurance when proof is not received in time.
- **Collateral protection annual premium** — the annual premium of collateral protection insurance, as a percentage of principal at placement.

## Notes on the table

- Only the Truck & Trailer Loan carries collateral protection; on every other product of the line the annual premium figure is 0 because no collateral protection is placed.
- The cure period on the Truck & Trailer Loan is 15 calendar days; on every other product it is 30.
